description: This file defines the `ExecAllowlistMatcher` enum with static methods for matching command resolutions against allowlist patterns, including pattern validation, normalization, and regex-based matching.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistMatcher
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to match executable entries against allowlist patterns with support for pattern validation, normalization, and regex matching.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a list of entries against a single command resolution, returning the first matching allowlist entry or nil if none match.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches a list of resolutions against a list of entries, returning all entries that match all resolutions.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a target string matches a pattern string, after normalization and pattern processing.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by replacing backslashes with forward slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Converts a pattern string with wildcards into a case-insensitive NSRegularExpression object.
